title: Orange orb lands near an open Minot missile silo
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: the morning and a UFO came over the base and apparently was like hovering and the guy was screaming like it's it's Landing

plain: Sometime between 1966 and 1968, one morning, an orange glowing object came over Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, hovered, and set down near a missile silo that was open, while a man there screamed that it was landing. The filmmaker James Fox tells Michels this from the material behind his film The Phenomenon, summing it up without naming the witness. If true, an unknown object came down right beside a nuclear missile.
